name: PixVerse
desc: AI video generation from text and images.
desc_zh: 文生图生视频工具，国内名为拍我AI
solves: Turns a still photo or a sentence into a short video clip without any 3D or editing skill.
solves_zh: 把一张照片或一句话变成短视频，不需要三维或剪辑基础。
best_for: You need a usable generated clip fast and cannot wait on a long queue.
best_for_zh: 要快速拿到能用的生成片段、等不起长队列时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：AICPB AI产品榜 出海总榜 App #5, 17.42M MAU。来源：https://www.aicpb.com/zh/ai-rankings/products/apps
